title: List orphan concepts in bee knowledge check
action: Extract the links_in test from show_concept into pub(crate) fn links_to(other_path, other_data, other_body, target_path) -> bool in author.rs; show_concept calls it. In check_bundle, after the bundle-level profile checks, for every concept of type bee.area or bee.pattern whose basename is not overview.md, collect its path into CheckReport.orphans when no other parsed concept links_to it; push one note with the count. Informational only (measured 207 of 351 unlinked on the repo bundle, so a warning would drown --strict): routing emits profile.orphans and counts.orphans in JSON, the NOTE line in text; the verdict never changes. One inline test in author.rs: a bundle with one linked and one unlinked pattern lists exactly the unlinked one, ok stays true under --strict. Update skills/bee-capturing/references/concept-authoring.md step 4 to name profile.orphans; run bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write).
verify: cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml author:: and knowledge; .bee/bin/bee knowledge check on the repo bundle stays OK; bee dev release-manifest --check
must_haves: knowledge check --json lists every unlinked area/pattern concept under profile.orphans and a NOTE carries the count
overview.md and non-area/pattern types are never listed
the check verdict, strict or not, is unchanged by orphans
show links_in and the orphan scan share one predicate

trace.behavior_change: bee knowledge check reports orphan area/pattern concepts (no inbound link) as a note and a JSON list, never as a failure
